note: The most load-bearing module in the project: agents read the game ONLY through a View. `oracle_opponent_hand` is the generator's own knowledge, recorded so a test can assert the invariant -- it is not part of any view, and no port should expose it. Three asymmetries matter: elder reads all five of his talon cards even when he takes fewer; he therefore watches younger draw cards he has already read; and each player may consult their own discards.
